name: Mi Pad 4

Body.Weight: Mi Pad 4: 342.5 g, Mi Pad 4 Plus: 485 g
Body.Other: Fingerprint scanner (front; Mi Pad 4 Plus), accelerometer, gyroscope, compass (LTE models)

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 8.1 Oreo + MIUI 9, Current: Android 8.1 Oreo + MIUI 10
Platform.CPU: Octa-core (4×2.2 GHz Kryo 260 Gold & 4×1.8 GHz Kryo 260 Silver)

Memory.RAM: Mi Pad 4: 3/4 GB, Mi Pad 4 Plus: 4 GB, LPDDR4X
Memory.Storage: Mi Pad 4: 32/64 GB, Mi Pad 4 Plus: 64/128 GB, eMMC 5.1

Display.Display: IPS LCD, 1200 × 1920 (WUXGA), 16:10, 274 ppi, Mi Pad 4: 8.0", 283 ppi, Mi Pad 4 Plus: 10.1", 224 ppi

Cameras.Rear camera: 13 MP Omnivision OV13855, 27.69 mm, 1/3.06", 1.12 μm PDAF, HDR, panorama, Video: 1080p@30fps, 720p@30fps
Cameras.Front camera: 5 MP Samsung S5K5E8, 2.64 mm, 85°, 1/5", 1.12 μm, HDR, Video: 720p@30fps

Battery.Battery: Non-removable, Li-Po, Mi Pad 4: 6000 mAh, Mi Pad 4 Plus: 8620 mAh

Connectivity.Connectivity: USB-C 2.0, 3.5 mm audio jack, Bluetooth 5.0 (A2DP, LE), Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac (dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot), LTE models: GPS, A-GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou
